severity.label: Severity
severity.guideTitle: What mild, moderate, and severe mean
severity.mildHelp: Child is alert and mostly active, eats and drinks normally, and symptoms cause only mild discomfort without stopping usual play or sleep.
severity.moderateHelp: Child is fussy or less active, may eat or drink less, and fever or pain clearly limits play, sleep, or comfort — but they still respond to you and take some fluids.
severity.severeHelp: Child is very unwell: hard to wake or console, refuses fluids, has breathing difficulty, repeated vomiting, a non-fading rash, seizures, or looks very sick to you.

growth.title: Growth Tracking
growth.patientOnly: Growth tracking is available for patient accounts.
growth.intro: Track your child's height, weight, and head circumference against WHO growth standards.
growth.recordingCadenceBody: Log at well-baby and check-up visits — about monthly in the first year, every 2–3 months as a toddler, and every 6 months after age 2. Add home weigh-ins between visits when you can.
growth.disclaimer: For informational purposes only. Consult your doctor for clinical interpretation.
growth.parentHeightHint: Optional — used to estimate genetic target height (mid-parental height). Enter standing heights in cm.
growth.parentHeightInvalid: Parent height must be between 100 and 250 cm.

midParentalHeight.title: Genetic height target (mid-parental height)
midParentalHeight.incomplete: Add both parents' heights in Edit child to see a genetic target for adult height and the ideal height line on the chart.
midParentalHeight.targetAdult: Predicted adult height: about {height} cm (typical range {low}–{high} cm).
midParentalHeight.expectedAtAge: Ideal height for current age (~{months} months): about {height} cm on the genetic target line.
midParentalHeight.latestAboveGenetic: Latest height reading is above the genetic target for this age — many healthy children run above their genetic line.
midParentalHeight.latestBelowGenetic: Latest height reading is below the genetic target for this age — track the trend over time; many healthy children run below their genetic line.
midParentalHeight.latestOnGenetic: Latest height reading is close to the genetic target for this age.
midParentalHeight.note: The teal dashed line on the Height chart shows expected height by age if your child follows this genetic target. Many healthy children sit above or below it — track the trend over time.
midParentalHeight.viewHeightChart: Open the Height chart tab to see the genetic target line on the graph.

growth.recordedDateHint: Pick the day the reading was taken — you can backfill older clinic or home visits.
growth.bmiTallLeanHint: BMI is lower on the BMI chart because your child is tall for their age while weight is in a typical range ({weightPct}%). Weight and height percentiles together are the best guide here.
growth.noChildYet: Add a child profile to start tracking growth.

chart.p50Importance: The middle of healthy growth for this age — a helpful benchmark to see whether your child is tracking near typical growth.
chart.p3Importance: A lower guide — readings often near or below this line are worth discussing with your doctor to check steady growth.
chart.p97Importance: An upper guide — readings often near or above this line help your doctor review whether growth is faster than expected.
chart.bmiContextHint: BMI-for-age can look low for tall, lean children. Weight at {weightPct}% is often the better signal for healthy weight — check weight and height percentiles together.

metricGuide.title: Which chart should I use?
metricGuide.weight: After a weigh-in (home scale or clinic) — see if your child is gaining weight steadily over time.
metricGuide.height: When height is measured at check-ups — shows how tall your child is growing long term.
metricGuide.bmi: When you have both height and weight — best from age 2 onward to check healthy proportions.
metricGuide.headCirc: Mainly for babies and toddlers under 3 — often measured at infant and well-baby visits.

percentileGuide.title: What does the % mean?
percentileGuide.intro: It compares your child to WHO reference children of the same age and sex — like a growth ruler, not a report card.
percentileGuide.example: 50% means about half of children measured higher and half measured lower at that age.
percentileGuide.positiveUse: Log readings at home or clinic visits to watch your child's own trend over time — steady growth along their curve is what matters most.
percentileGuide.doctorVisit: Share this history at check-ups so your doctor can celebrate progress and plan next steps early.
percentileGuide.bmiNote: BMI-for-age can be low for tall children even when weight is healthy — always read BMI together with weight and height percentiles.

percentileHint.typical: Healthy range — keep logging to build a clear growth story.
percentileHint.watch: Slightly off the middle band — track the trend and mention it at your next visit.
percentileHint.discuss: Worth a quick doctor review — bringing this history helps you stay ahead.

smartWatch.title: Smart watch
smartWatch.intro: Sync heart rate, steps, and other wellness readings from your smart watch through Apple Health or Google Health Connect.
smartWatch.choosePlatformHint: Choose your watch brand or health app. This only saves your choice — it does not connect your watch yet.
smartWatch.setupIntro: Complete these steps on your phone to sync readings:
smartWatch.syncTitle: Readings we can sync (once Health access is enabled)
syncItems: Blood oxygen (SpO₂) when your watch records it
smartWatch.statusNotSyncing: Not syncing yet — your watch is not connected to Agastya.
smartWatch.pendingSyncHint: No readings are being imported yet. Finish the steps below in the Agastya mobile app and allow Health or Health Connect access.
smartWatch.savedToast: Watch type saved. Your watch is not syncing yet — complete setup in the mobile app.
smartWatch.webOnlyTitle: Connect on your phone — not in this browser
smartWatch.webOnlyBody: Websites cannot pair with smart watches or read Apple Health / Health Connect. Install the Agastya mobile app on the same phone as your watch, then tap Connect Health data there.
smartWatch.webConnectSteps: Follow these steps on your Android phone:
smartWatch.webConnectStep1: Install or open the Agastya Healthcare app on your phone.
smartWatch.webConnectStep2: Go to Growth → Smart watch, pick your watch brand (e.g. Fire-Boltt), then tap Connect Health data.
smartWatch.webConnectStep3: Allow Health Connect access. Make sure your watch app (e.g. Fire-Boltt) shares data to Health Connect first.
smartWatch.connectHealthPrompt: Tap Connect Health data below to link your watch readings through Google Health Connect.
smartWatch.notConnectedYetNote: Saving here does not pair or connect your watch. Real sync starts only after you allow Health or Health Connect in the Agastya mobile app.
smartWatch.mobileAppNote: Web browsers cannot read Apple Health or Health Connect directly. Install the Agastya mobile app on your phone to complete sync.

fire_boltt.label: Fire-Boltt
steps: Install the Fire-Boltt app and confirm your watch is paired and syncing steps or heart rate.
On Android, install Google Health Connect. In Fire-Boltt settings, enable sync to Health Connect or Google Fit if available.
Install the Agastya Healthcare app on the same phone.
In Agastya mobile, open Smart watch and allow Health Connect access when prompted.

apple_watch.label: Apple Watch
steps: On iPhone, open the Watch app and confirm your Apple Watch is paired.
Open Settings → Health → Data Access & Devices and ensure your watch shares data with Apple Health.
Install the Agastya Healthcare app on the same iPhone.
In Agastya mobile, open Smart watch and allow Apple Health access when prompted.

wear_os.label: Wear OS / Pixel Watch
steps: On your Android phone, open the Google Pixel Watch or Wear OS app and confirm the watch is connected.
Install Google Health Connect from the Play Store if it is not already installed.
In Health Connect, allow your watch or companion app to write heart rate, steps, and sleep data.
Install the Agastya Healthcare app, open Smart watch, and allow Health Connect access.

samsung_galaxy.label: Samsung Galaxy Watch
steps: Open Samsung Health on your phone and confirm your Galaxy Watch is connected.
In Samsung Health settings, enable sync to Health Connect (Android) or Apple Health (iPhone).
Install the Agastya Healthcare app on your phone.
In Agastya mobile, open Smart watch and allow Health Connect or Apple Health access.

fitbit.label: Fitbit
steps: Open the Fitbit app and confirm your watch is syncing to your Fitbit account.
On Android, link Fitbit to Health Connect. On iPhone, enable sharing to Apple Health if available.
Install the Agastya Healthcare app on the same phone.
In Agastya mobile, open Smart watch and allow Health Connect or Apple Health access.

terms.subhero: Online medical consultation for your baby
terms.updatedBody: These terms apply when you use Agastya Healthcare telehealth and online booking services for pediatric care.
terms.s1Body: Agastya Healthcare offers online information, scheduling, and remote consultations related to pediatric and family health. Online sessions are not a substitute for an in-person examination when your clinician recommends one, and not all concerns can be assessed safely by video or chat.
terms.s2Body: If your baby has trouble breathing, turns blue or gray, is unresponsive, has a seizure, severe bleeding, or any life-threatening symptom, call your local emergency number immediately. Do not use this site or online consultation to request emergency care.
terms.s2bBody: Our Smart AI chat provides general health guidance only and is not a doctor, diagnosis tool, or substitute for professional medical advice. Smart AI responses may be incomplete or unsuitable for your specific situation. You must seek a qualified clinician for diagnosis and treatment decisions, and you must use emergency services for urgent or life-threatening symptoms.
terms.s3Body: You must be a parent or legal guardian (or their authorized representative) to register a minor and to consent to care. You agree that information you provide about the child is accurate to the best of your knowledge.
terms.s4Body: Medical judgment depends on many factors. We do not guarantee specific results, diagnoses, or treatments from any online interaction. Your clinician may recommend in-person follow-up, tests, or referrals.
terms.s5Body: We use information you submit to provide care, operate appointments, and improve our services, consistent with applicable law and our internal policies. Video or chat sessions may be documented in the medical record where clinically appropriate.
terms.s6Body: Remote visits depend on your device, connection, and environment. Poor audio, video, or incomplete information may limit what we can advise. You agree to join from a private space when possible and not to record sessions without prior agreement where required by law.
terms.s7Body: You are responsible for safeguarding your login credentials. You will not misuse the platform, impersonate others, or upload harmful content. We may suspend access for violations or security concerns.
terms.s8Body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Agastya Healthcare and its staff are not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from use of this website or online consultations. Some jurisdictions do not allow certain limitations; in those cases, our liability is limited to the maximum allowed by law.
terms.s9Body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms. The “Last updated” note above may be revised when we publish changes.
terms.s10Body: For questions about these terms or your care, use the contact options shown on our website or ask your care team during your next visit.

privacy.hero: Privacy Notice — personal and health data
privacy.subhero: How we handle your information when you use Agastya Healthcare telehealth services
privacy.updatedBody: This notice supplements our Terms & Conditions. It is designed to meet transparency expectations under India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP) for digital personal data. It is not legal advice; engage qualified counsel to finalize wording for your deployment.
privacy.s1Body: Agastya Healthcare operates this website and telehealth services. For DPDP purposes, we act as a data fiduciary for personal data processed through this platform, subject to our agreements with you and applicable law.
privacy.s2Body: We collect identifiers and contact details you provide (such as name, email, phone), account credentials, appointment and clinical context needed for care (including child health information you share), session and support metadata, and technical data needed to run video consultations and secure the service (for example device/browser signals and security logs).
privacy.s3Body: We use personal data to provide telehealth consultations and scheduling, authenticate users, deliver prescriptions and care documentation where applicable, send operational communications, improve reliability and safety of the service, comply with law, and respond to support requests. We do not sell your personal data.
privacy.s4Body: Where DPDP or other law requires consent for specific processing, we will ask for it clearly (for example at registration or before optional features). You may withdraw consent where processing is consent-based, subject to legal or clinical record-keeping obligations.
privacy.s5Body: Health-related information you share during consultations may be sensitive. We protect it with access controls, encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS), and additional safeguards described in our security practices. Retention follows clinical, legal, and operational requirements.
privacy.s6Body: We share personal data with service providers who help us operate the platform (such as hosting, email, or video infrastructure) under contracts that require protection of your information. We may disclose information if required by law or to protect rights, safety, and security.
privacy.s7Body: Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction, or erasure of your personal data; receive information about processing; nominate a representative; and seek grievance redressal. We will respond within timelines prescribed by law where applicable. For grievances, use the contact channel published on this site.
privacy.s8Body: If personal data is transferred outside India, we do so in line with DPDP requirements (including permitted territories or appropriate safeguards as prescribed).
privacy.s9Body: Our pediatric services are directed at parents and guardians. Do not provide information about a child unless you have authority to do so.
privacy.s10Body: We may update this notice to reflect legal, technical, or service changes. Material updates will be highlighted where appropriate. Continued use after updates constitutes notice of the revised policy where permitted by law.
